scientific_integrity: The proof uses Hilbert's basis theorem and Noetherian atomicity to establish factorization, preserves a nonunique constant factorization to prove non-UFD behavior, and applies the exact formal product rule to obtain L-additivity. The explicit \(\mathbb Z[\sqrt{-5}]\) example is checked by its multiplicative norm. Finite computation is used only as regression evidence.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is an existence result for the broad class \(A[X]\) with \(A\) Noetherian and non-UFD; it does not classify all non-UFD factorization domains and does not construct the factorization-normalized arithmetic derivative that sends chosen irreducibles to \(1\).
title: Polynomial-ring derivations answer the non-UFD L-additivity question
